title: DAILY FIGHTER — WEEK 2 DAY 10
emphasis: Saturday MEDIUM adjusted for AC-joint symptoms: floor compression, shoulder-sparing upper strength, belt-squat loading, spinal-engine control, rotational power mechanics, and repeatable intervals

levels.bonus: Optional 5–10 min easy mobility. BJJ: Ignition + A×2/B×1/D×1 (19:10), or skip if class/time load is high.

ignition.name: Curved-Treadmill Intervals
ignition.cue: RPE 5; smooth stride and conversational recovery

deposits.label: A
deposits.title: COMPRESSION FOUNDATION REGRESSION
deposits.effort: Rest 1:05; RPE 6, 5 RIR. Last qualifying hanging-knee-raise exposure: 3×7 on 9/12; 3×8 on 9/16 was missed. No progression. Gates remain two clean 3×8 knee-raise and 3×20-sec tuck-support exposures ≤RPE 8 after symptoms permit.

exercises.name: Dopa Band Hollow Tuck Crunch
exercises.cue: Posterior pelvic tilt; exhale into compression; no hanging

deposits.label: B
deposits.title: SHOULDER-SPARING UPPER STRENGTH
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; 4 RIR, RPE 6. Establish a pain-free baseline; no overhead work, deep extension, or progression.

exercises.name: Dopa Band Rear Delt Row
exercises.cue: Elbows comfortable; shoulder blade moves without shrugging

exercises.name: Dopa Band Triceps Pushdown
exercises.cue: Upper arms quiet; pain-free shoulder position; full elbow finish

deposits.label: C
deposits.title: SQUAT STRENGTH + SPINAL ENGINE
deposits.effort: Rest 1:15; belt squat 3 RIR/RPE ≤8. Record load; missing exact prior load means no credited load progression.

exercises.name: Belt Squat
exercises.cue: Torso tall; knees track; drive evenly

exercises.name: Dopa Band Bicycle Crunch
exercises.cue: Rotate through upper back; pelvis stays controlled; smooth tempo

deposits.label: D
deposits.title: ROTATIONAL + LOWER POWER
deposits.effort: Rest 0:45; RPE 6. Power shifts replace throwing while the AC joint is symptomatic; stop when speed, distance, landing, or posture declines.

exercises.name: Dopa Band Power Shifts
exercises.cue: Load hip, rotate through the floor, and brake cleanly

exercises.name: Broad Jump
exercises.cue: Quiet landing; reset every rep; stop when distance drops

deposits.label: E
deposits.title: INTERVAL ENGINE + LATERAL ARMOR
deposits.effort: Rest 0:20; RPE 7. Keep sprint rhythm and lateral-lunge posture repeatable across all rounds.

exercises.name: Dopa Band Standing Sprints
exercises.cue: Fast contacts; ribs stacked; same output each round

exercises.name: Dopa Band Ankle-Resisted Lateral Lunge
exercises.cue: Sit into the hip; trailing leg long; push back under control

martialSupplement.name: Dopa Band Resistant Leg Pummeling
martialSupplement.home: Dopa Band + mat: controlled guard-retention leg pummeling
martialSupplement.cue: Relax shoulders; move from hips; solo work supplements coaching
